Ethos is a passion project, my passion project.

Ethos is a tool that simplifies data collection, the hardest part of the data analysis process.

Who am I? My name is Matt, and I like data. A little over a 2 years ago I started working for a small online retail company as an IT contractor/Systems Analyst. I designed the company network, built servers & workstations, installed phones, edited web pages and served as the help desk. This was all well and good, but then I started doing other things for the company involving Excel and formulas. Manipulating company data was really fun! I could look at sales for the past years, compare time periods... then I created my first model to predict out-of-stock dates for products. I learned VBA on the job, and using Microsoft Access, was able to develop a company database. I had never touched a programming language in my life (unless you count HTML), and I created something you could log into, manage user permissions, update product information, push information to our sales channel, pull data into the database, query sales data, and much more. It was amazing!

I quit my job. I decided that messing with data was the most fulfilling thing I could do with my life, and to do it I needed to learn to program effectively. The past 8 months I have started a company (www.neurorithm.com /shamless plug), and set out teaching myself HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python and PHP.

I believe that data collection is the most tedious, time consuming part of any analysis project. Data that is freely available on the Internet comes in a variety of formats and I plan to make a tool that makes data collection simple.

Ethos is a tool that simplifies the hardest part of the data analysis process, and it is my passion project.
